description: A client-side mod that turns Minecraft's whisper system into a full private messaging experience.

mods.name: Whisper Mod
mods.description: A better private chat experience — DM players without retyping /w every message.

releases.notes:
What's New in v1.5.0
--------------------

### Reply System

- Incoming whispers from players outside your session now show **[Reply]** and **[Start Session]** / **[Switch Chat]** buttons
- `/wm reply <player>` - send a one-off reply without starting a session
- HUD and in-chat label update to show the reply target while replying
- Automatically clears after the message is sent

### Session Improvements

- EM session auto-ends if your partner disconnects from the server
- `/wm dm` now correctly closes an active EM session when switching

### Block List

- `/wm blocked` - view all players you have blocked

### Bug Fixes

- `/wm mute` no longer toggles off if already muted — shows an error instead
- Manual `/w` commands now display as `[DM]` instead of `[player -> player]`
- `/wm help` reorganized into logical sections

releases.notes:
## What's New in v1.4.1

### Friend Notifications
- Get notified when a friend joins or leaves the server
- `/wm status` - see all your friends with online/offline indicators

### Mute System
- `/wm mute` - mutes all incoming friend and EM requests (do not disturb)
- `/wm mute <player>` - silently mute a specific player's requests (they have no idea)
- `/wm unmute` - unmute all requests
- `/wm unmute <player>` - unmute a specific player
- `/wm muted` - view your muted players and global mute status

### Request Timers
- Friend requests show how many seconds remain when you try to double-send
- EM requests now have the same timer (30 second window)

### Sound Effects
- Pling sound when you receive a friend request
- Amethyst chime when you receive an EM session request

### Bug Fixes
- `/wm friend`, `/wm dm`, and `/wm em` now reject offline or nonexistent players

releases.notes:
## What's New in v1.4.0

### Friend System
- `/wm friend <player>` — send a friend request
- `/wm unfriend <player>` — remove a friend (notifies them)
- `/wm friends` — view your friend list
- `/wm pending` — view pending outgoing requests
- Friend requests expire after 60 seconds
- EM sessions now require friendship first

### Block System
- `/wm block <player>` — block someone from sending you requests
- `/wm unblock <player>` — unblock someone (notifies them)
- Blocking a friend automatically unfriends them and notifies them
- Sending a friend request to someone who blocked you notifies you immediately

### Clickable Chat
- Friend and EM requests now show clickable **[Accept]** and **[Decline]** buttons in chat
- `/wm help` is now fully clickable

### Visual Polish
- All mod notifications unified under a `[WM]` purple tag
- `[DM ★]` shown for messages from friends
- Consistent color scheme — green for good news, red for bad news

### Other
- Friend and block lists saved locally to `.minecraft/config/whispermod/`
- Tab completion filters by context — friends for `/wm em`, blocked for `/wm unblock`
- Block and unfriend only work when the target is online

releases.notes:
## What's New in v1.3.2
> Encrypted messaging only works correctly on servers using EssentialsX and similar plugins
### Bug Fixes
- **Fixed DM message formatting** — DM sessions now suppress the server echo and display messages cleanly as `[DM] name: message`
- **Fixed outgoing echo processing** — Protocol messages you send no longer get echoed back and processed as incoming, eliminating duplicate notifications and false "me wants to start a session" triggers
- **Fixed receiver-side decryption** — Messages sent during an EM session are now correctly decrypted on the other end
- **Fixed own messages not appearing** — Your messages in EM chat now show immediately when sent
- **Fixed re-requesting EM after `/wm back`** — Sessions are fully cleared on exit so you can start a new one right away

### New
- **Synced session exit** — When either player presses `← Back` or runs `/wm back`, both players are exited from the EM session automatically
- **No Response timer** — If an encrypted session request goes unanswered for 30 seconds, you'll be notified that they may not have the mod installed

### Polish
- **Consistent EM colors** — Player names now show in aqua in EM chat on both sent and received messages

## What's New in v1.3.1
